title: Research on solar fuels based on azobenzene/g-C3N4 photoinduced isomerization energy storage
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,6280-6293
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00900F, Paper
Li Zhang, Yonglei Jin, Jing Jin, Yazhu Zhang, Changcheng Guo, Haofeng Wang, Suxia Liu, Shaopeng Guo, Erdem Cuce
Successfully grafted azobenzene molecules onto graphite-like phase carbon nitride templates and prepared four novel solar thermal fuel materials, providing a theoretical basis for the application of azobenzene in the field of solar energy storage.
